title: Information Bottleneck-Guided Adaptive Hypergraph Transformer for Brain Disease Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2609.37220v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Exploring high-order correlations and long-range dependencies in brain networks holds significant value for both neuroscience research and clinical diagnosis. However, previous studies have lacked a unified integration of high-order and long-range dependency information in brain networks, and there is substantial redundancy behind various types of information. These issues limit their effectiveness in the diagnosis of brain diseases. To address this, we propose an Information Bottleneck-Guided Adaptive HyperGraph Transformer (IBAHGT). By incorporating the information bottleneck (IB) principle, this approach enables adaptive learning of high-order correlations and both short- and long-range dependencies within a unified framework for brain network analysis, achieving high-precision brain disease diagnosis. translated_title: 信息瓶颈引导的自适应超图Transformer用于脑部疾病诊断
translated_abstract: 探索脑网络中的高阶相关性和长程依赖对神经科学研究和临床诊断都具有重要价值。然而，以往的研究缺乏对脑网络中高阶信息与长程依赖信息的统一整合，且各类信息背后存在大量冗余，这些问题限制了其在脑部疾病诊断中的有效性。为解决这一问题，我们提出了信息瓶颈引导的自适应超图Transformer（IBAHGT）。通过引入信息瓶颈（IB）原理，该方法能够在统一框架内对脑网络分析中的高阶相关性以及短程和长程依赖进行自适应学习，从而实现高精度的脑部疾病诊断。IBAHGT由三个关键组件构成：信息瓶颈引导的自适应超图卷积，该组件引入了一种新颖的超（摘要在此处截断，后续内容缺失）
tldr: 该论文提出IBAHGT模型，通过信息瓶颈原理在统一框架内自适应学习脑网络的高阶相关性与短程及长程依赖，并有效去除信息冗余，实现高精度脑部疾病诊断。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes IBAHGT, which incorporates the information bottleneck principle to adaptively learn high-order correlations and short- and long-range dependencies in brain networks within a unified framework, reducing information redundancy and achieving high-precision brain disease diagnosis.
